title: [BE][Karaz][Customer][Signup] - Account is created without verifying the mobile number (no OTP)
summary: `POST /Customers/Subscribe` creates an active customer immediately, with no OTP or any other proof that the person owns the mobile number. Anyone can register any number, including someone else's. The real owner is then blocked from registering ("Mobile number is already registered"), and orders and notifications go to an account they don't control. The spec defines an OTP purpose `SIGNUP` (10 min expiry, 3 attempts), but the client bundle contains no OTP or verification endpoint at all.
steps:
1. Open `http://169.58.165.26/KarazEndUser/` and click إنشاء حساب.
2. Fill: name `QA Tester Karaz`, mobile `0599999001`, a valid password, country فلسطين / state جنين / city جنين, and an address.
3. Click إنشاء حساب.
4. Log in straight away with the same number and password.
expected: An OTP is sent to the number, and the account is activated only after the code is verified. Source: `C_OTP_PURPOSES_TB` row `SIGNUP` (EXPIRES_MINUTES 10, MAX_ATTEMPTS 3); the ER doc lists `CUSTOMER_OTP_TB`.
actual: `200 {data:{id:4, userName:"970599999001", ...}}` and the account can log in immediately. The bundle's endpoint map has only `Customers/Login`, `Customers/Subscribe`, `ChangePassword`, `GetProfile` and `UpdateProfile`, with no OTP or verify endpoint.
layer:
| API | Subscribe creates an active account with no verification step |
| UI | No OTP screen exists |
impact: Anyone can take over a phone number's identity, and real owners can be locked out. Combined with the no-rate-limit duplicate check, the signup endpoint can also be used to find out which numbers are registered. **High**: integrity of customer identity.
evid: Request/response 2026-10-03 (customer #4, created for QA). Static review of `assets/index-DIQJPpoa.js`.
notes: The same gap applies to `ORDER_CONFIRM` (orders aren't confirmed by OTP) and `PASSWORD_RESET` (no reset flow exists). See bug `karaz-eu-no-password-recovery`.

title: [FE][Karaz][Customer][Products] - Product cards and favorites show rounded prices (99.99 shown as 100 ILS)
summary: Product list cards and the Favorites list round prices to whole numbers. The blouse (product 3) costs **99.99 ILS** in the API but is shown as **100 ILS**. The cart and checkout correctly use 99.99, so the customer sees a different price before and after adding to cart.
steps:
1. Log in as a customer → المنتجات.
2. Find بلوزة اوفر سايز (store رونق): the card shows `100 ILS`.
3. Add it to favorites → المفضلة: it also shows `100 ILS`.
4. Compare with `GET /Products/GetProducts` → `price: 99.99`.
expected: Prices shown with the currency's decimal places (`DECIMAL_PLACES` = 2 for ILS): `99.99 ILS`, the same as on product details and in the cart.
actual: `100 ILS` on the cards and in favorites; `30.00 ILS` style (2 decimals) on product details and in the cart.
layer:
| UI | Card/favorite price formatter rounds to integer |
| API | Correct (`99.99`) |
impact: Every product with a fractional price. Customers see a price that doesn't match the cart. Consumer-protection risk. **Medium**.
notes: The admin dashboard has the same rounding (299.97 → 300): see admin bug `karaz-dashboard-revenue-currency`.

title: [BE][Karaz][Customer][Checkout] - Orders/Checkout takes ~14 seconds to respond
summary: Placing a 1-item order took **13.7 s** server time (`POST /Orders/Checkout`). Other calls on the same server answer in 90–250 ms. During that time the customer sees only a spinner, which invites double submits or abandoned checkouts.
steps:
1. Log in as a customer and add 1 item to the cart (product 2, size M).
2. Cart → enter an address → إتمام الطلب → تأكيد الطلب.
3. Watch the duration of `POST /Orders/Checkout` in DevTools.
expected: Checkout responds within ~1–2 s. Side effects such as notifications (SignalR/Firebase) run asynchronously.
layer: | API | Slow checkout; likely synchronous work after the order insert (the admin notification was created at 13:36:29, the order at 13:36:28) — *assumption* |
impact: Every order. Risk of abandoned carts and repeat clicks. **Medium**.
notes: Measured once. Re-measure under normal load before prioritising.

title: [BE][Karaz][Customer][Account] - Existing session stays valid after password change; logout is client-only
summary: After a successful password change, the same bearer token keeps working: the very next authenticated call (changing the password back) succeeded with it. Logout makes no server call and only clears the browser state. A stolen token therefore survives both a password change and a logout. The token is also stored in a cookie readable by scripts (`karaz_customer_access_token`, HttpOnly=false, Secure=false) over plain HTTP.
steps:
1. Log in as a customer.
2. Profile → تغيير كلمة المرور: change it to a new valid password → success.
3. Without logging in again, change it back → success with the same token.
4. Log out from the avatar menu: no request is sent to the API.
expected: Changing the password invalidates all other sessions (or at least requires a new login), and logout revokes the token on the server. Tokens live in HttpOnly/Secure cookies on HTTPS.
actual: The token stays valid after the password change. Logout is client-only. The cookie isn't HttpOnly or Secure.
layer:
| API | No token revocation / no security-stamp check |
| UI | Logout only clears local state |
impact: Account takeover persists after the victim resets their password. **Medium** (needs a stolen token first).
evid: ChangePassword 200 → 200 with the same session, 2026-10-03. No API request on logout.
notes: The admin portal behaves the same way (F-01, F-12).

title: [FE & BE][Karaz][Customer][Login] - No forgot-password / password-recovery flow
summary: The customer login screen has no "Forgot password" link, and the client bundle has no reset endpoint. A customer who forgets their password has no way back into their account and can't re-register, because the number is already taken. The spec defines OTP purpose `PASSWORD_RESET` (15 min expiry, 5 attempts).
steps:
1. Open `http://169.58.165.26/KarazEndUser/`.
2. Look for any password-recovery option on the login form.
expected: A "Forgot password?" link → enter mobile → OTP (`PASSWORD_RESET`) → set a new password.
actual: No link, no screen, no endpoint.
layer:
| UI | Missing screen |
| API | No reset endpoint in the client's API map |
impact: Customers who forget their password are locked out for good. **Medium**: support burden and lost customers.
evid: Login page and bundle endpoint map, 2026-10-03.

title: [FE & BE][Karaz][Customer][Profile] - Profile edits are blocked until an email is added, but signup never asks for email
summary: Signup doesn't collect an email, but the profile form makes email mandatory. A new customer who tries to change their name, phone or address gets "يرجى تعبئة الاسم والبريد والجوال" (fill in name, email and phone) and can't save anything until they first add an email.
steps:
1. Register a new customer (signup has no email field).
2. Profile → تعديل → change the name → حفظ.
expected: Email is optional in the profile (because it's optional at signup), or signup collects it.
actual: Client blocks the save with `يرجى تعبئة الاسم والبريد والجوال`. It works only after an email is added.
layer:
| UI | Profile form treats email as required |
| Data | New customers have `email: null` |
impact: Every new customer who wants to update their address before ordering. **Medium**.
workaround: Add any valid email first, then edit the other fields.

title: [BE][Karaz][Customer][Cart] - AddToCart accepts any quantity (100,000 units → 3,000,000 ILS cart)
summary: The cart API validates quantity > 0 but has no upper limit and no stock concept. A quantity of 100,000 was accepted, giving a cart line of 3,000,000 ILS, which could then be checked out as an order the store must handle.
steps:
1. As a logged-in customer: `POST /KarazCustomersApi/api/Carts/AddToCart` with `{productId:2, quantity:100000, fieldValues:[{fieldId:3, optionId:16}]}`.
2. Open السلة.
expected: A sensible maximum per line (and/or stock check) with a clear 400 message.
actual: `200 {cartItemId:10, quantity:100000, totalPrice:3000000}`. Cart total `3000030.00 ILS` (no thousands separators). The line was removed again after the test.
layer:
| API | No max-quantity rule |
| UI | +/- buttons have no upper bound either |
impact: Junk or abusive orders reaching stores. **Medium**.

title: [FE & BE][Karaz][Customer][Orders] - Customer cannot open an order, see its items/address, track delivery or cancel it
summary: My Orders lists orders as cards (number, date, total, item count, status), but the cards can't be clicked. There's no order details view, no delivery tracking (the spec has delivery states Ready / In Transit / Delivered / Failed), and no way for the customer to cancel a New order. Only an admin can cancel.
steps:
1. Place an order (order #8).
2. طلباتي → الحالية → click the order card.
expected: An order details view (items with options, address, totals, status history, delivery status), and a cancel action while the status is New. Source: spec `CUSTOMER_ORDER_ITEMS_TB`, `ORDER_DELIVERIES_TB`, delivery states 8–11.
actual: Clicking does nothing. The API map has only `Orders/GetOrders` and `Orders/Checkout`.
layer:
| UI | No details screen |
| API | No customer order-details / cancel endpoint |
impact: Customers can't check what they ordered or where it is. **Medium**.
evid: Orders screen and bundle endpoint map, 2026-10-03.
klass: Missing feature / spec gap: confirm scope with PO

title: [BE][Karaz][Customer][API] - Business-rule errors return HTTP 500 instead of 400/404/409
summary: Several expected, user-caused errors are returned as **500 Internal Server Error**, which hides real server faults in monitoring and can trigger generic error handling in clients.
steps:
1. `POST /Orders/Checkout` with an already-ordered or non-existent `cartId` → 500 `Active cart not found`.
2. `POST /Customers/UpdateProfile` with a mobile already used by another customer → 500 `رقم الجوال مسجل مسبقاً`.
3. `POST /Customers/ChangePassword` with a wrong current password → 500 `كلمة المرور الحالية غير صحيحة`.
impact: Monitoring noise, and clients can't tell user errors from outages. **Low**.

title: [FE][Karaz][Customer][Cart] - Cart badge shows 0 after login until the cart page is opened
summary: The app calls `GET /Carts/GetCart` on the login screen (twice, 401 Unauthorized) and doesn't refetch after a successful login. A customer whose cart already has items sees `سلتي 0` until they open the cart page.
steps:
1. As a customer, add an item to the cart, then log out.
2. Log back in: the sidebar shows `سلتي 0`.
3. Open سلتي: the item is there and the badge changes to 1.
expected: Fetch the cart after login (and skip the pre-login calls).
actual: Badge 0 until the cart page is opened. Two 401 `GetCart` calls on every visit to the login page.
layer: | UI | Query not invalidated on auth change |
impact: Customers think their cart is empty. **Low**.
